verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
verses.translation: Woe to the stinters;

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.translation: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share;
but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.
Do they not realise that they will be raised to life
on a Great Day,
a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verses.translation: No indeed! Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!
And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?
It is a Book inscribed.
Woe, then, to those that give the lie,
those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.translation: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translation: who, when Our verses are recited to him, says: “Mere tales of olden times!”

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.translation: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.translation: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,
and then they shall enter Hell,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translation: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.translation: No indeed! Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.
And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?
It is a Book inscribed,
which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.
Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;
resting on couches, looking around.
You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.
They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,

verses.arabic: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
verses.translation: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –
a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,
a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.translation: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:
when they passed by them they winked,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.translation: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.translation: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;
(they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.translation: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;
seated upon their couches, they are looking around.

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.translation: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?
